name: 使所有元素的异或为零所需的最小操作次数
englishName: Minimum Operations to Make XOR of All Elements Zero
hints: Let x be the XOR of all elements. Handle the cases where x == 0 or all elements are equal first.
Replacing a with a ^ b changes the total XOR by b. Consider the smallest subset of original elements whose XOR equals x.
If this subset has size d, the answer is d when d < nums.length, and -1 otherwise.
Find d using BFS from XOR value 0. Each transition XORs the current value with a distinct value from nums. All reachable XOR values are less than 2048.
